name: RA_RECUR_INTERIM
description: The RA_RECUR_INTERIM table temporarily holds invoices that Oracle Receivables will copy in the future. Receivables deletes these records after the records are successfully loaded into permanent Receivables invoice tables. For example, if you create a recurring invoice for $1200 over 12 months, Receivables temporarily holds the invoice that you created for January in this table until the identical invoices are generated. . The primary keys for this table are CUSTOMER_TRX_ID and TRX_NUMBER.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the original invoice from which to recur invoices

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: The transaction number of the newly recurred invoices

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: The transaction date of the newly recurred invoice

columns.name: TERM_DUE_DATE
columns.description: The due date of the first installment of the newly recurred invoice

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: The General Ledger date of the newly recurred invoice

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: DOC_SEQUENCE_VALUE
columns.description: The value of the document sequence

columns.name: NEW_CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the new recurred invoice

columns.name: BILLING_DATE
columns.description: Billing date for balance forward transactions
